papers.title: Sickle cell haemoglobin status shapes malaria parasite genotype in asymptomatic infections
papers.abstract: Distinct Plasmodium falciparum genotypes underlie equal rates of asymptomatic infection in sickle cell haemoglobin carriers and non-carriers, indicating that sickle cell haemoglobin impacts parasite populations before exerting its known protective effects against malaria symptoms.
papers.titleZh: 鐮刀型血紅素狀態形塑無症狀感染的瘧原蟲基因型
papers.summaryZh: 該研究指出，在鐮刀型血紅素帶因者與非帶因者中，無症狀感染的發生率相同，但感染的瘧原蟲基因型不同。研究聚焦於瘧原蟲Plasmodium falciparum，發現兩組個體所攜帶的基因型具有差異。這暗示鐮刀型血紅素對瘧原蟲族群的影響發生在發揮其已知保護作用、降低瘧疾症狀之前。結果顯示保護效應可能與感染前期的寄生蟲組成變化有關。

papers.title: Linking live-cell imaging to single-cell sequencing using genetic barcoding
papers.abstract: Linking cellular phenotype to genotype and gene expression is a central goal in biomedical research. Live-cell imaging captures dynamic cellular phenotypes, whereas single-cell sequencing measures genome-wide molecular states, but pairing these readouts for the same cell remains challenging. Here we present Waldo, a genetically encoded single-cell barcoding strategy that can be read out by both live-cell imaging and single-cell sequencing to connect single cells across both modalities. Waldo barcodes are generated by combinatorial expression of synthetic cell-surface receptors, each detected by a cognate peptide probe coupled either to a fluorescent dye or a DNA barcode. Iterative fluorescent probe staining achieves large barcode diversity, while preserving fluorescence channels for phenotypic reporters. As a proof-of-principle, we use Waldo to link cell division phenotypes after chromosome missegregation to the karyotype and transcriptome of the same cells. Waldo provides a general strategy for connecting imaging phenotypes to genome-wide sequencing readouts in single cells.
papers.titleZh: 利用基因條碼連結活細胞影像與單細胞定序

papers.title: Spatial organization of fibroblast subpopulations and niches across acute repair and chronic fibrotic remodeling of the human myocardium
papers.abstract: Myocardial fibrosis is a common end point of acute and chronic cardiovascular injury, yet the spatially organized fibroblast (Fb) and immune-cell states that sustain fibrotic remodeling across etiologies remain incompletely defined. We applied cyclic in situ hybridization (cISH)-based spatial transcriptomics to myocardial biopsies from patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI), ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM), hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), postviral myocardial fibrosis (PVMF), and systemic sclerosis associated primary heart involvement (SSc-pHI). CODEX-based protein imaging provided orthogonal support for cell subpopulations and cellular neighborhoods. Spatially informed clustering identified six Fb subpopulations: COL1A1hi/POSTNhi, NOTCH3+, TIMP1hi, GSNhi/DCNhi, AP1hi Fbs, and myofibroblasts. COL1A1hi/POSTNhi and NOTCH3+ Fbs were enriched in AMI, whereas GSNhi/DCNhi Fbs and myofibroblasts predominated in chronic fibrotic remodeling. These subpopulations displayed distinct extracellular matrix, inflammatory, and vasoregulatory programs. Infarction-associated reparative niches were enriched in COL1A1hi/POSTNhi or NOTCH3+ Fbs and SPP1+ or APOE+ macrophages (M{Phi}), whereas chronic fibroinflammatory niches were enriched in GSNhi/DCNhi or AP1hi Fbs or myofibroblasts with C1Q+ M{Phi} and plasma cells. The GSNhi/DCNhi Fb niche marked areas of subendocardial fibrosis, whereas the AP1hi Fb niche localized to perivascular fibrosis. In SSc-pHI, the actively fibrogenic COL1A1hi/POSTNhi Fb state characteristic of infarct scar formation was present at higher frequency than in other chronic entities and was individually associated with cardiac dysfunction, whereas the chronic GSNhi/DCNhi Fb niche was associated with the extent of interstitial fibrosis and anti-topoisomerase I autoantibodies. These data show that human myocardial fibrosis is organized into spatially distinct Fb subpopulations that assemble into context-specific fibroinflammatory niches across chronic fibrotic remodeling and repair after AMI.
papers.titleZh: 人類心肌急性修復與慢性纖維化重塑中纖維母細胞亞群與微環境的空間組織

papers.title: HyperCom: a hypergraph-based method to infer cell-resolved cell-cell communication
papers.abstract: Cell-cell communication underpins intercellular responses allowing cells to dynamically change states across conditions; however current methods typically aggregate signals by cell type annotations which may introduce biases. We developed HyperCom, a hypergraph-based method to infer cell-resolved cell-cell communication from single cell transcriptomics data. HyperCom constructs a hypergraph from known ligand-receptor interactions and the expression of those ligands and receptors in individual cells and performs graph diffusion on the hypergraph to score cells on a continuous spectrum from sender to receiver for each LR pair. HyperCom then generates a cell-type agnostic ranking of LR pairs by communication either over the whole dataset or in a condition-aware manner. Validation of HyperCom on physical cell-to-cell contact, spatial, and multicondition datasets highlight its flexibility to capture subtle per cell communication information. HyperCom is available as a species-agnostic, scalable, and open source R package: https://github.com/pawelab/HyperCom.
papers.titleZh: 基於超圖的單細胞解析細胞間通訊推論方法
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊開發了 HyperCom，一種基於超圖的方法，用於從單細胞轉錄組數據推論細胞解析度的細胞間通訊。HyperCom 以已知配體-受體交互作用與個別細胞中配體與受體的表現建構超圖，並在超圖上進行圖擴散，為每個配體-受體配對對細胞從發送者到接收者的連續光譜進行評分。方法可產生細胞類型無關的配體-受體配對通訊排名，並可在全資料集或條件感知方式下進行。作者在物理細胞接觸、空間與多條件資料集上驗證 HyperCom，指出其能捕捉細微的逐細胞通訊資訊。HyperCom 以物種無關、可擴展且開源的 R 套件形式提供。

papers.title: scStable: assessing scRNA-seq analysis stability under bulk-derived between-sample variation
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) studies often profile only one or a few biological samples, limiting assessment of discovery stability under between-sample variation. We present scStable, a framework for assessing scRNA-seq analysis stability by generating synthetic samples that preserve cell-level heterogeneity from a single-sample reference while injecting bulk-derived between-sample variation. In gastric cancer data comprising 21 matched scRNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq profiles, scStable better recapitulates observed between-sample variation than ZINB-WaVE, subsampling, and Gaussian noise injection. Using synthetic sam-ples, scStable enables stability-aware analysis, including prioritization of stable differentially expressed genes and selection of clustering methods and hyperparameters.
papers.titleZh: scStable：評估單細胞RNA定序分析在基於bulk樣本間變異下的穩定性

papers.title: A dual-metric framework for quantifying the biological fidelity of scRNA-seq pipelines
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution transcriptional profiling, but early-stage processing pipelines differ markedly in barcode recovery, UMI correction, and read assignment-variations that can propagate and bias downstream analyses. We present a reproducible, parameter-aware benchmarking framework to quantify the biological fidelity of four primary pipelines-STARsolo, Cell Ranger, Kallisto|Bustools, and Alevin-fry-across simulated ground-truth datasets and complex biological contexts, including a Huntington's disease (HD) mouse model. Our approach introduces two complementary metrics: the Cluster Annotation Score (CAS), assessing concordance between direct cell-level and cluster-level consensus labels, and the Marker Concordance Score (MCS), measuring cohesion of de novo marker genes per cell type. By systematically varying highly variable gene (n_HVG) and principal component (n_PC) settings, we map how upstream quantification interacts with downstream parameter choice. Simulations show STARsolo and Kallisto|Bustools deliver high technical accuracy, but only STARsolo consistently preserves stable cell identities and coherent marker expression across parameter regimes. In empirical datasets, alignment-based pipelines (STARsolo, Cell Ranger) yield higher CAS/MCS values and more biologically faithful annotations, while alignment-free methods show reduced signal fidelity despite faster runtimes. Differences introduced during primary processing persist after batch correction and integration, altering disease-associated cell type detection. Our open-source CAS-MCS-Scoring toolkit enables transparent evaluation of pipeline performance, providing a practical guide for selecting analysis strategies that maximize reproducibility and biological interpretability in scRNA-seq studies.
papers.titleZh: 量化 scRNA-seq 管線生物保真度的雙指標框架
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出一套可重現且參數感知的基準框架，用以量化四種主要 scRNA-seq 初級處理管線的生物保真度，包括 STARsolo、Cell Ranger、Kallisto|Bustools 與 Alevin-fry，並在模擬真實資料集與亨丁頓氏症小鼠模型等複雜生物情境中進行評估。框架引入兩項互補指標：Cluster Annotation Score（CAS）評估細胞層級與群集層級共識標籤的一致性，Marker Concordance Score（MCS）衡量每種細胞類型的從頭標記基因凝聚度。系統性改變高變異基因數 n_HVG 與主成分數 n_PC 的結果顯示，上游定量方式會與下游參數選擇交互作用。模擬顯示 STARsolo 與 Kallisto|Bustools 具高技術準確性，但僅 STARsolo 能在不同參數範圍內穩定保留細胞身份與一致的標記表現；在實證資料中，依賴比對的管線 CAS/MCS 值較高，而免比對方法雖執行更快但訊號保真度較低。

papers.title: Additive-input encoding fails operator-level target-held-out prediction on current Perturb-seq screens
papers.abstract: Pooled Perturb-seq screens are often interpreted through a linear steady-state model in which each targeted gene supplies an additive perturbation input. Although this formulation identifies an operator on the observed response subspace in closed form, identifiability alone does not establish that inferred operators generalize to new perturbation targets. We evaluated fixed program-space additive inputs in three Perturb-seq screens -- Replogle K562 essential, Replogle RPE1 essential, and Jost 2020 -- using target-grouped nested cross-validation and matched signal-to-noise linear-truth controls. For inverse operator prediction, real held-out error remained at the predict-zero baseline (0.96, 1.00, and 1.00), whereas matched linear controls achieved 0.18, 0.53, and 0.72. This discrepancy persisted across random K562 target panels, an overdetermined Jost dimension sweep, direction-only fits, ridge and truncated-SVD estimators, and five linear ground-truth ensembles. Forward target-held-out prediction was more nuanced: fixed, footprint, and learned linear encodings modestly beat a predict-training-mean baseline in K562 but not in RPE1 or Jost, and the K562 gains recovered only about 7% of the gap to the matched linear control. On the tested screens, fitted fixed program-space operators should not be interpreted as validated target-generalizing regulatory operators. We release anchor-op, a reproducible toolkit for target-grouped evaluation, identifiability checks, and matched-geometry positive controls for perturbation-response models.
papers.titleZh: 加性輸入編碼在現有 Perturb-seq 篩選中無法進行目標保留的算子預測
papers.summaryZh: 該研究檢驗了在 pooled Perturb-seq 篩選中常見的線性穩態模型，假設每個被靶向基因提供加性擾動輸入，並評估其推斷的算子是否能推廣到新靶點。作者針對 Replogle K562 essential、Replogle RPE1 essential 與 Jost 2020 三個篩選，使用目標分組巢狀交叉驗證及配對訊噪比的線性真實對照進行評估。在逆算子預測中，實際保留目標的誤差維持在預測為零基準，分別為 0.96、1.00、1.00，而配對線性對照分別達到 0.18、0.53、0.72，且差異在多種估計器與設定下持續存在。前向目標保留預測在 K562 中僅 modestly 超過預測訓練均值基準，在 RPE1 與 Jost 中未見改善，且 K562 的提升僅收回約 7% 的差距；作者因此指出在測試的篩選中，擬合的固定程序空間算子不應被視為已驗證的目標泛化調控算子，並釋出 anchor-op 工具包供重現評估。

papers.title: VINTER: a generative vision-language model for annotating and interrogating spatial tissues
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics links gene expression to tissue structure, yet current models learn embeddings whose meaning is assigned afterwards or read histology without measured expression. Tissue decisions are therefore rarely made from morphology, genes and neighbourhood together, or examined through them. Here we introduce VINTER, a generative vision-language model aligned on 1.45 million histology-caption pairs that reads histology, measured gene expression and spatial neighbourhood as one sequence. It returns the probability of every tissue class, and because genes enter as text, its molecular evidence can be edited with the image held fixed. Reading all three sources together, VINTER annotated tissue more accurately than spatial-domain methods and a spatial foundation model, and transferred across cohorts without target labels. Editing only the neighbourhood resolved the follicular B-cell and plasma-cell programmes behind its reading of tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) maturation in lung and kidney cancer. Its class probabilities exposed what single labels conceal in triple-negative breast cancer: immune heterogeneity within stroma and cancer hidden beneath benign labels. Without retraining, the same model transferred to Visium HD and single-cell Xenium data and resolved follicular architecture within colorectal cancer TLS. VINTER thus turns spatial annotation into an interrogable reading of tissue across platforms and resolutions.
papers.titleZh: VINTER：用於註解與探究空間組織的生成式視覺語言模型

papers.title: Spatial mitochondrial lineage tracing uncovers a premetastatic niche and microenvironment programmed fate switching in osteosarcoma
papers.abstract: Osteosarcoma progression involves complex spatiotemporal dynamics, yet the lineage relationships underlying tumor cell fate decisions remain poorly understood. Here we integrate single cell and spatial transcriptomics and mitochondrial variants-based lineage tracing to map the evolution of a late-stage, non-metastatic osteosarcoma. Single cell pseudotemporal reconstruction of malignant cells reveals a stepwise cascade of transcriptional programs that are associated with bifurcation of COL3A1+ progenitors into ALPL+ osteoblastic and THY+ mesenchymal lineages. Critically, we demonstrate that the metastatic THY1+ mesenchymal cell fate is not governed by cell-autonomous transcriptional programs alone; this pro-tumorigenic state is associated with spatial co-localization with PLVAP+ dysfunctional endothelia to form a pro-metastatic niche (THY1_Endo) enriched for PTN/NOTCH signaling. To distinguish clonal ancestry from microenvironmental plasticity, we leveraged spatially resolved somatic mitochondrial variants as endogenous lineage tracers. A spatial autocorrelation filter confirmed significant clonal spatial coherence (Z = 10.07, p {approx} 4 x 10-24). Phylogenetic reconstruction using a Wright-Fisher drift model coupled with a hidden Markov tree (WF-HMT) identified COL3A1+ cells as the ancestral tumour state with ALPL+ and THY1+ states acquired repeatedly and independently across the phylogeny. We propose a "time-space-lineage" relay model where sequential microenvironmental signals are associated with tumor cell fate and pre-metastatic niche assembly through clonal commitment. This multi dimensional framework bridges single cell states, spatial organization, temporal dynamics, and clonal ancestry - underscoring the power of somatic mitochondrial variants to resolve clonal history and intercept cancer evolution.
papers.titleZh: 空間粒線體譜系追蹤揭示骨肉瘤中的轉移前微環境與微環境程式化命運轉換

papers.title: FlyAnatoView: Visualization of Drosophila Single-cell RNA-seq Datasets on Anatomographs
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is a powerful approach for measuring the transcriptomic landscape at single-cell resolution. However, while scRNA-seq data reveals what genes each cell expresses, they do not indicate where that cell was located within the tissue or organ, anatomically. We developed FlyAnatoView (https://www.flyrnai.org/tools/rna_seq_base/web/svg_files/), a resource that projects scRNA-seq data onto anatomical diagrams, restoring this missing spatial context.
papers.titleZh: FlyAnatoView：將果蠅單細胞RNA定序資料投射至解剖圖
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊開發了 FlyAnatoView，這是一個可將單細胞RNA定序資料投射到解剖圖上的資源。單細胞RNA定序能以單細胞解析度測量轉錄體景觀，但無法顯示細胞在組織或器官內的解剖位置。FlyAnatoView 透過將資料對應到解剖圖，補回這項缺失的空間脈絡。該工具的網址為 https://www.flyrnai.org/tools/rna_seq_base/web/svg_files/。

papers.title: Inhibitory Nectin-2/TIGIT interactions between CD163+ macrophages and CD8+ T cells in spatially defined immune niches associate with poor outcomes in neuroblastoma
papers.abstract: Background: While immunotherapies have transformed outcomes in several adult cancers, more than half of pediatric patients with high-risk neuroblastoma fail to achieve sustained responses, resulting in poor outcomes. Therefore, understanding the phenotypic and spatial organization of immune cells within the neuroblastoma tumor microenvironment is essential to identify mechanisms driving immunotherapy failure. Methods: To identify spatial determinants of the neuroblastoma immune landscape that may contribute to treatment failure, we dissected immunoregulatory mechanisms at single-cell and protein levels in neuroblastoma samples from 28 patients, using imaging mass cytometry (IMC, n=14) and high-dimensional spectral flow cytometry (n=18). Results: We characterized four distinct cellular neighborhoods, ranging from tumor-dominant to stromal and immune niches. Macrophages were broadly distributed across these niches. In contrast, T and B cells were largely confined to immune niches, forming immature tertiary lymphoid structure-like aggregates within the tumor and stromal cores. T cells displayed a CD69+ tissue-resident memory phenotype, with an overall reduced cytotoxic profile (in CD8+ T cells) and increased expression of inhibitory receptors (predominantly in CD4+ T cells), indicative of dysfunctional features. Intriguingly, T cell functional states differed between spatial niches, with a TCF7+/Ki-67+ self-renewing profile within immune niches, and increased granzyme B expression in CD8+ T cells in tumor cores. Interaction analysis pinpointed CD163+ macrophages as the dominant immunosuppressive interaction partner of T cells, particularly within the tumor edge and immune cores. Analysis of inhibitory ligand-receptor interactions identified the TIGIT/PVR/Nectin-2 axis as the main engaged axis between CD163+ macrophages and T cells. Nectin-2 expression on macrophages was particularly high within immune cores, and elevated in macrophages with direct T cell contact, suggesting a high probability of in situ engagement. Consistent with this immunosuppressive role, both CD163 and Nectin-2 expression on macrophages correlated with poor patient survival, substantiating the clinical relevance of inhibitory macrophage-T cell interactions. Conclusions: This study reveals T cell-excluded tumor niches and targetable inhibitory interactions between CD163+ macrophages and T cells. These insights provide a rationale for combinatorial immunotherapeutic strategies that both enhance T cell infiltration into tumor-rich areas and disrupt inhibitory signaling to improve immunotherapy efficacy in neuroblastoma.
papers.titleZh: CD163+巨噬細胞與CD8+ T細胞間Nectin-2/TIGIT抑制性交互作用與神經母細胞瘤預後不佳相關
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊以28名神經母細胞瘤患者的樣本，結合影像質譜細胞儀IMC與高維度光譜流式細胞儀，探討腫瘤微環境中免疫細胞的表型與空間分布。分析辨識出四種不同的細胞鄰域，從腫瘤主導到基質與免疫區，巨噬細胞廣泛分布於各區，而T細胞與B細胞主要侷限於免疫區，形成類似未成熟第三型淋巴結構的聚集。T細胞呈現CD69+組織駐留記憶表型，CD8+ T細胞的細胞毒性整體降低，且CD4+ T細胞以抑制性受體表現增加為主，顯示功能失調特徵。空間分析顯示T細胞功能狀態依區位而異，免疫區內為TCF7+/Ki-67+自我更新型，而腫瘤核心中CD8+ T細胞顆粒酶B表現增加。交互作用分析指出CD163+巨噬細胞是T細胞在腫瘤邊緣與免疫核心中最主要的免疫抑制性互動夥伴，且TIGIT/PVR/Nectin-2軸為CD163+巨噬細胞與T細胞間主要被啟用的抑制性配體-受體軸，巨噬細胞在免疫核心中的Nectin-2表現特別高，且與T細胞直接接觸的巨噬細胞表現更高。

papers.title: Coordinated alterations in SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex, mRNA splicing and mRNA methylation as hallmarks of salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma (SACC)
papers.abstract: Salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma (SACC) is a rare, poorly understood malignancy. Here, using spatial transcriptomics, we show that disturbances in epigenetic regulation including chromatin remodeling, epitranscriptomic control by m6A RNA methylation, and RNA splicing may contribute to SACC. We demonstrated that machineries responsible for these processes-SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex (CRC), NineTeen Complex (NTC), and m6A RNA methylation complex interact directly. Immunohistochemistry on 48 SACC tumor samples indicated altered abundance of METTL3, METTL14, WTAP (m6A RNA methylation) and PRP19, CDC5L, PLRG1 (NTC-splicing) proteins. Chromatin immunoprecipitation indicated direct regulation of genes encoding subunits of SWI/SNF, NTC and RNA methylation complexes, and some EMT (epithelial-to-mesenchymal) marker genes by BRM (BRAHMA). Transcriptomic re-analysis revealed broad alterations in transcript usage, and splicing events in SACC. Collectively, our findings provide the first evidence that coordinated disruption of chromatin remodeling, RNA methylation, and splicing contributes to SACC development and progression, highlighting new avenues for therapeutic exploration.
papers.titleZh: SWI/SNF 染色質重塑複合體、mRNA 剪接與 mRNA 甲基化在唾液腺腺樣囊性癌的協同改變
papers.summaryZh: 唾液腺腺樣囊性癌（SACC）是一種罕見且研究不足的惡性腫瘤。研究團隊以空間轉錄體學分析，顯示表觀遺傳調控的異常，包括染色質重塑、m6A RNA 甲基化所介導的表觀轉錄體控制，以及 RNA 剪接，可能與 SACC 有關。研究指出負責這些過程的機器——SWI/SNF 染色質重塑複合體（CRC）、NineTeen Complex（NTC）與 m6A RNA 甲基化複合體彼此直接交互作用。對 48 例 SACC 腫瘤樣本的免疫組織化學染色顯示，m6A RNA 甲基化相關蛋白 METTL3、METTL14、WTAP，以及 NTC 剪接相關蛋白 PRP19、CDC5L、PLRG1 的豐度改變。染色質免疫沉澱結果顯示 BRM（BRAHMA）直接調控編碼 SWI/SNF、NTC 與 RNA 甲基化複合體亞基的基因，以及部分上皮-間質轉化標記基因。轉錄體再分析亦發現 SACC 中轉錄本使用與剪接事件的廣泛改變。

papers.title: Olaparib plus tremelimumab in women with recurrent ovarian cancer and a germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation: a phase I/II study
papers.abstract: Response rate to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) in ovarian cancer remains low and combinatorial strategies are needed. Here the authors report the results of a phase I/II study of the PARP inhibitor olaparib and the anti-CTLA4 antibody tremelimumab in women with recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer and a germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutation.
papers.titleZh: PARP 抑制劑奧拉帕利合併抗 CTLA-4 抗體治療復發性卵巢癌
papers.summaryZh: 本研究為一項針對帶有胚系 BRCA1 或 BRCA2 突變的復發性上皮性卵巢癌女性患者的第 I/II 期研究，評估 PARP 抑制劑 olaparib 與抗 CTLA-4 抗體 tremelimumab 的組合。研究背景指出卵巢癌對免疫檢查點阻斷療法的反應率仍低，需要組合策略。作者報告了該組合療法的研究結果。

papers.title: Bacterial toxin sensing induces transient inflammasome-dependent innate immune memory that improves survival during sepsis
papers.abstract: This study shows that the bacterial toxin CNF1 can train innate immune cells to respond more effectively to subsequent infections, revealing a form of immune memory that improves survival during sepsis in mice.
papers.titleZh: 細菌毒素誘發短暫發炎體依賴先天免疫記憶
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出細菌毒素 CNF1 能使先天免疫細胞對後續感染產生更有效的反應。作者將此現象描述為一種免疫記憶形式。研究發現該記憶與發炎體依賴有關，且具有短暫性。於小鼠模型中，此類訓練可改善敗血症時的存活。

papers.title: APOE2 attenuates APOE4-associated amyloid pathology and related toxicity in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s disease
papers.abstract: Chen and colleagues use a heterozygous mouse model carrying human APOE2 and APOE4 alleles to show that APOE2 attenuates APOE4- associated effects on brain amyloid pathology and related cellular and molecular changes.
papers.titleZh: APOE2 減輕 APOE4 相關阿茲海默症小鼠模型的類澱粉病理與毒性
papers.summaryZh: Chen 等人使用攜帶人類 APOE2 與 APOE4 等位基因的雜合小鼠模型進行研究。研究顯示 APOE2 能減弱 APOE4 相關的腦部類澱粉病理。該效應也與相關的細胞與分子變化有關。此結果在阿茲海默症小鼠模型中探討了 APOE 等位基因間的交互作用。

papers.title: Contrasting plant trait strategies underpin ecosystem stability in temperate and alpine grasslands
papers.abstract: Stable grasslands are vital for sustaining ecosystem functions under environmental change. The study shows that plant functional traits support stability through contrasting pathways in temperate and alpine grasslands.
papers.titleZh: 溫帶與高山草原的植物性狀策略對比與生態系穩定性
papers.summaryZh: 穩定草原對於在環境變遷下維持生態系功能至關重要。本研究指出，植物功能性狀在溫帶與高山草原中透過不同的途徑支持穩定性。研究顯示兩類草原在維持穩定性的植物性狀策略上存在對比。

papers.title: Distinguishing learning asymmetry from perseveration in behavioral models
papers.abstract: A tendency to repeat previous choices can easily be mistaken for learning differently from positive and negative outcomes. This study reveals why this is a fundamental problem and introduces methods to distinguish genuine learning biases from perseveration.
papers.titleZh: 區分學習不對稱與固著行為
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，重複先前選擇的傾向容易被誤認為是對正負結果學習方式不同。作者說明這為何是根本性的問題，並提出方法來區分真正的學習偏誤與固著行為。研究強調在行為模型中辨識兩者的差異的重要性。

Reward function compression facilitates goal-dependent reinforcement learning
paper.abstract: People can learn to achieve arbitrary goals, but this flexibility requires cognitive effort. Here, the authors show that the brain resolves this by progressively compressing complex reward information into simplified rules, freeing up working memory to facilitate reinforcement learning.

paper.title: Error semitransparent universal control of a bosonic logical qubit
paper.abstract: Error transparency is an alternative approach to quantum fault-tolerance relying on multi-body Hamiltonians whose evolution is unaffected - to first order - by noise. Here, the authors show a dynamic encoding subspace framework achieving universal control of Bosonic logical qubits with error semitransparent gates, correcting most single-photon loss errors in the Bosonic mode during logical gate operations.

paper.title: Emergence of polarization in networks of large language model agents
paper.abstract: Large language model agents can now communicate, form networks, and develop opinions, but their collective behaviour remains poorly understood. Here, the authors show that networked LLM agents can spontaneously develop polarized opinions and serve as a synthetic testbed for studying opinion dynamics.
